It will carry your guitar and your suitcase. … Oliver: What about Ingrid? … Maya: She says she'll be a ship captain and explore the Arctic. … Oliver: And Diego will have his own TV programme, for sure. … Maya: And Kili? … Oliver: Kili won't change. He'll always be the best postman in the world!
